title: Event colors now match their category, all-day events get icons, preview bars go full width
summary: Fixed a real bug: event colors were coming from the feed's own color swatch, not the category the rules engine actually assigned -- so a holiday/all-day event could show a color that didn't match its category at all. Colors now come from the event's category.

All-day event lines (both the full Calendar page and the Home preview) now show a small dot with the category icon next to the title, matching the timed-event bars instead of being plain colored text.

Fixed event bars in the Home widget's mini calendar preview not spanning the full cell width -- the mini cell centers its content (for the day number), which was also shrink-wrapping the event bars instead of letting them stretch like the full calendar's day cells already do.
